summary: Iteration 37: Comprehensive testing of new NexusOps features - On-Call Roster, Workshop Jobs, Field Jobs/WISP, Auto-Reorder. Backend APIs 25/26 tests passing (96%, 1 skipped). Frontend UI fully functional with all new features integrated into existing pages.

minor.issue: Route ordering issue - templates endpoint was being caught by /{job_id} route. FIXED by moving templates and stats/summary routes before dynamic {job_id} route.

issues: Minor: Chart width/height warnings in console - charts render with negative dimensions initially. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering in FastAPI matters - static paths must be defined before dynamic {param} paths to avoid 404s
seed_data_creation: Test data cleaned up after each test. Existing seed data: WS-1001 (workshop job), FJ-1001 (field job), Alex Thompson on-call shift (wisp category)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 37 tested all new batch features. All features working correctly. On-Call Roster on Technicians page shows Currently On Call banner with pulsing green badge, Ping/Schedule buttons, View Full Roster expandable. Tickets page has 3 tabs: Tickets (26), Workshop, Field Jobs. Workshop tab shows stats, job list with WS-XXXX numbers, status progression. Field Jobs tab shows stats, zone badges, job list with FJ-XXXX numbers. Field job detail has interactive checklist (6 items for installation), Signal/Speed test input fields.
